processing: decode (float) -> segment -> resample to 48 kHz (polyphase) -> stereo -> onset (-50 dB re peak) at 5 ms, cut where the level stays below -60 dB -> 5 ms fade-in, 20-50 ms fade-out -> sample peak -1 dBFS. peak_time = centre of the loudest 10 ms. lufs = integrated (BS.1770), files < 0.4 s zero-padded to 0.4 s.

align_help.onset: sync the start (t=0.005) to the event
align_help.peak: put peak_time on the cut / landing / join
